featured_reviews.name: Janhavi Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bhaucha Dhakka Fish Market is a massive and bustling fish market. The entire area is surrounded by fishermen’s boats, and it’s fascinating to watch the process as fresh fish is unloaded directly from the boats and handed over to sellers waiting at the port.

There’s a huge crowd, with fish being sold in bulk at lower prices, and the variety is impressive. Thousands of crates filled with different kinds of fish make the place feel alive and energetic. Watching the fish-selling women calling out to customers and negotiating adds to the authentic market atmosphere.

Overall, it was a really memorable experience to witness everything happening in real time. On one side, construction work is going on, possibly to extend the market, which actually seems necessary since the place is quite congested.

featured_reviews.name: Gupta Rohit
featured_reviews.review_text: Best place to buy Fish in Mumbai if you are sea food lover and want them at reasonable prices. The quantity you get is enough for couple of days of medium size family. You have to negotiate a little with them as initial prices are always higher. People although charge you higher but are also helpful at the same time that is something strange. If you want lower quantity of you do not have storage, you can buy from outside the dock gate. The price will be higher but still cheaper than most of mumbai. Otherwise go straight till place where ships are docked. There you find good deal. Market Opens as early as 5.30 AM and remains till 2.30 PM.

featured_reviews.name: Sampath Iyengarr
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this redeveloped residential building while checking access and surroundings near Andheri market.

The tower has a modern façade with a stilt-plus-podium layout, clear entry signage, and a wide internal driveway that eases vehicle movement. Landscaping along the compound wall is still maturing, and common areas appeared functional rather than decorative.

Best suited for residents who want a newer building within walking distance of daily markets and transit links.

Better finishing around boundary walls would improve first impressions.

Overall, a practical redevelopment in a convenient Andheri location.
Visited. Observed. Shared.
